status.heading: Status
status.replay_help: When Renown is installed, every member gets the XP their past activity earned: no daily caps or cooldowns apply to history, only to activity after install. Nobody is moved into Prestige automatically: a member whose history is worth more than Level 100 sits at Level 100 (the top rank) with the extra XP banked, and Prestige is ready for them to take. The replay runs in the background (the scheduler, this page while it's open, or php flarum renown:rebuild). History means everything before Renown was installed: replaying it again never pays twice for activity since then, and posts that are hidden at the time earn nothing.
status.replayed: History replayed. New activity earns XP as it happens.
status.failed: That didn't work. Reload the page and try again.
status.confirm_rebuild: Replay history again with the XP values saved now? XP earned since install stays, and so does every Prestige. Posts hidden right now earn nothing until they're restored.
status.confirm_reset: Reset everyone to Level 1 with no XP, no Prestige and no emblems? This can't be undone, and history is not replayed. Replaying it afterwards only gives back what was earned before Renown was installed.

rules.heading: Anti-farming
rules.help: These apply to activity after install, never to the history replay. A running Double XP event multiplies the caps too. 0 turns a rule off. Days reset at midnight UTC, for the caps and the daily visit.
rules.cap_daily_help: The most XP a member can earn in a day, all sources together. Staff adjustments don't count.
rules.cap_corkboard: Daily XP cap for finished cards
rules.cap_panels_read: Daily XP cap for chapters read
rules.cap_panels_read_help: The most XP a member can earn in a day from reading chapters. Each chapter pays once, and never its own uploader.
rules.cap_corkboard_help: The most XP a member can earn in a day from Corkboard cards. A card pays only once, at least an hour after it was made, on a board with a team, and only when someone else made it or it has a checklist or a comment.
rules.cap_likes_help: The most XP a member can earn from likes in a day.
rules.likes_per_giver: Likes counted per member per day
rules.likes_per_giver_help: How many likes from the same member count toward someone's XP each day.
rules.min_length_help: Replies shorter than this many characters earn no XP. Quoted text doesn't count.
rules.cooldown: Seconds between posts that earn XP
rules.cooldown_help: A reply or discussion posted sooner than this after the last one earns nothing.
rules.exclude_tags_help: Posts in these tags never earn XP.

ranks.heading: Ranks
ranks.help: 20 ranks of five grades each (I to V): 100 levels. Leave a name empty to use the default. Uploaded icons replace the drawn insignia (PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF, shown at up to 112px). A group reward is given at that rank and taken back below it, unless it is kept for good.

tiers.heading: Prestige tiers
tiers.help: Twenty tiers, then Eternal. A tier's group is held while it is the member's tier, or for good if kept.

boosts.heading: Double XP events
boosts.help: While an event runs, live XP and the daily caps are multiplied. An event tied to a tag counts only for activity in that tag. A banner shows on the discussion list during the event and the day before.
